news.headline: Delcath Systems (DCTH) Sets New 52-Week High Amid Analyst Upgrade Wave
news.summary: DCTH shares touched a fresh 52-week high as Zacks Research upgraded the stock to Strong Buy and Wall Street Zen upgraded it to Buy, extending the post-earnings rally into a second week.

news.headline: Delcath Systems Amends Bylaws to Designate Delaware as Exclusive Litigation Forum
news.summary: Delcath's Board adopted amended and restated bylaws making the Delaware Court of Chancery (or federal court for the District of Delaware) the exclusive forum for internal corporate claims, and federal district courts the exclusive forum for Securities Act claims.

news.headline: Delcath Systems to Participate at the Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference
news.summary: Delcath management presented at the Canaccord Genuity growth conference in Boston on August 11, 2026, keeping the stock in front of healthcare investors following the Q2 beat.

news.headline: H.C. Wainwright Raises Delcath Systems Price Target to $32 from $30, Reiterates Buy
news.summary: H.C. Wainwright lifted its price target on DCTH shares following the strong Q2 print, citing accelerating HEPZATO volumes and the raised full-year revenue outlook; BTIG separately raised its target to $21 from $17.

news.headline: Delcath Systems Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results and Business Highlights
news.summary: Q2 revenue rose to $29.1M (versus ~$26.3M consensus), with HEPZATO KIT revenue of $27.1M, gross margin expanding to 90%, and net income of $2.7M; management raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $104M-$108M and activated two more treatment centers, bringing the active total to 31 toward a year-end target of 37.

news.headline: Delcath Systems Announces First Patient Dosed in Phase 2 Clinical Trial of HEPZATO in Liver-Dominant Metastatic Breast Cancer
news.summary: The first patient was dosed at the European Institute of Oncology in Milan in a new investigator-initiated Phase 2 study of HEPZATO in HER2-negative, liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer, extending the platform beyond uveal melanoma.

catalysts.label: US site network expansion
catalysts.detail: Company guidance calls for roughly six more HEPZATO treatment centers to go live, reaching 37 active US sites by year-end 2026 (31 active as of Q2), with 40 centers targeted by Q1 2027.

catalysts.label: FDA pre-IND meetings for new indications
catalysts.detail: Management plans pre-IND discussions with the FDA to pursue additional HEPZATO indications beyond uveal melanoma, building on early breast and colorectal cancer signal data.

catalysts.label: Phase 2 metastatic breast cancer trial enrollment
catalysts.detail: Investigator-initiated Phase 2 study of HEPZATO in HER2-negative liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer is enrolling across activated sites following the first patient dosed in July 2026.

catalysts.label: Phase 2 metastatic colorectal cancer trial
catalysts.detail: Sponsored Phase 2 trial of HEPZATO as add-on therapy in liver-dominant metastatic colorectal cancer is actively screening across US and European centers, with primary endpoint results anticipated around mid-2028.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Delcath's next quarterly results and updated site-activation commentary are expected in the November 2026 reporting window (exact date not yet announced).

pulse: Delcath continues to ride strong commercial momentum into mid-August 2026: a Q2 revenue beat of $29.1M (versus roughly $26M consensus) on about 30% year-over-year HEPZATO volume growth prompted management to raise FY2026 revenue guidance to $104M-$108M, triggering a wave of analyst price-target hikes (H.C. Wainwright to $32, BTIG to $21) and upgrades from Wall Street Zen and Zacks that pushed shares to fresh 52-week highs. The active US treatment-center network is expanding toward 37 sites by year-end, and the company amended its bylaws in mid-August to set Delaware as the exclusive litigation forum, a routine governance update rather than a business signal. Near-term catalysts remain execution-driven (site activation cadence, FDA pre-IND talks on new indications, ongoing Phase 2 trials in breast and colorectal cancer) rather than binary regulatory events, with Q3 2026 results expected around November.
